visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women stand in a modern, well-lit room. The woman in the foreground wears a soft pink cardigan and white top, gesturing towards her face and then out towards the camera while speaking. Behind her, two other women stand still; one wears a grey beanie and glasses with a green top, and the other wears a lavender cardigan. The background features a desk with a computer monitor, bookshelves, and a window with horizontal blinds. (2) The woman in the foreground moves out of the shot. The two remaining women begin a rhythmic, synchronized dance, placing their hands on their chests and stomachs while moving their torsos in a pulsing motion. Their facial expressions are playful, with smiles and exaggerated breathing movements. The woman who left briefly reappears in the background, laughing. (3) The woman in the lavender cardigan leans toward the camera, smiling broadly and waving with one hand as the video concludes. The other woman in the beanie remains visible behind her, also smiling.
